name: Nippon Paint Bodelac Synthetic High Gloss Enamel Paint
shortDescription: Heavy-duty alkyd enamel paint offering excellent opacity, high weather durability, and smooth levelling on metal structures, machinery, and wood.
overview: Nippon Paint Bodelac is a premium synthetic enamel engineered with advanced Japanese coating resin technology to provide an exceptionally durable, high-gloss protective finish on ferrous metals, steel structures, and woodwork. Featuring superior leveling and brushability, it flows effortlessly without leaving brush streaks or sagging on vertical surfaces. Its UV-resistant formula repels moisture and withstands intense tropical weathering, making it the preferred coating for factory machinery, outdoor pipelines, and architectural steelwork.
keyFeatures: Superior leveling and flow characteristics produce a smooth, streak-free enamel film
Deep, high-luster gloss enhances visual appearance of fabricated equipment
High opacity and hiding power reduces the number of coats required to achieve full color depth
Strong resistance to cracking, flaking, chalking, and environmental weathering
Excellent adhesion to red oxide and zinc chromate metal primer undercoats
Resists mild industrial chemical splashes, grease, coolant spills, and frequent washdowns
Available in a wide range of standard industrial machine colors (RAL shades)
applications: Industrial machinery repainting, lathe beds, and press frames
Structural steel beams, pipe racks, and overhead crane gantries
Commercial steel gates, roll-up shutter doors, and security grilles
Exterior wooden trim, decking railings, and boat cabin surfaces
